description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core API controller for authentication endpoints, including user registration and login, interacting with an authentication service.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Controller managing authentication endpoints for user registration and login, utilizing dependency-injected authentication service.

methods.name: AuthController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the authentication service dependency.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new user and returns a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles POST requests for user login and returns a JWT token upon successful authentication.
